items.text: पञ्चकास्त्वष्ट विज्ञेया गणश्चैकस्त्रिकात्मकः वेत्ता नवगणस्यास्य संस्कर्ता गुरुरुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गुरुभक्तिः प्रसादश्च मतेर्द्वंद्वजयस्तथा धर्मश्चैवाप्रमादश्च बलं पञ्चविधं स्मृतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: व्यक्ताव्यक्तं जयच्छेदो निष्ठा चैवेह पञ्चमी द्रव्यं कालः क्रिया मूर्तिर्गुरुश्चैवेह पञ्चमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ज्ञानं तपो ऽथ नित्यत्वं स्थितिः सिद्धिश्च पञ्चमी गुरुजनगुहादेशः श्मशानं रुद्र एव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वासश्चर्या जपध्यानं सदारुद्रस्मृतिस्तथा प्रसादश्चैव लाभानामुपायाः पञ्च निश्चिताः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मिथ्याज्ञानमधर्मश्च सक्तिहेतुश्च्युतिस्तथा पशुत्वं मूलं पञ्चैते तन्त्रे हेयाधिकारतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
